text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In today's race,
I will rise again like the
phoenix.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a dramatic victory and become
a symbol of rebirth! And then my
Machan dolls will be a big
hit all across
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to put Machan dolls into
mass
production... How exciting!
